The day of the Arima Kinen had finally 
arrived. The public's attention was fully 
fixed on the showdown between Agnes 
Tachyon and Manhattan Cafe.

The "fruits of research" and the "cheers 
of the fans" cultivated up to this 
point... and... "the presence of a rival."

Having gathered all the ingredients needed 
to reach the "edges of possibility"... 
Agnes Tachyon steps up to take on the 
Arima Kinen!
